weapon.d:
Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1).
Unit can counterattack regardless of foe's range.
For unit and allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+X (for unit, X = 16; for allies, X = 5), grants an additional bonus to unit's or ally's Atk/Spd/Def/Res = highest bonus on each stat between target and foes within 2 spaces of target (calculates each stat bonus independently), and grants Special cooldown count-1 to unit or ally before unit's or ally's first attack and Special cooldown count-1 to unit or ally before unit's or ally's first follow-up attack during combat.
Unit deals +25 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's attacks by 15 (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's Specials by an additional 15 during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and restores 10 HP to unit after combat.
Unit can use the following【Arcane Style】:
――――― Arcane Nin-Axe Style ―――――――
Unit can attack foes 2 spaces away (unit cannot attack adjacent foes).
Unit deals +10 damage during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
Cannot move through spaces within 2 spaces of foe that has triggered the Bulwark effect (does not apply if unit has a Pass skill). Unit suffers a counterattack if any of the following conditions are met: foe is armored with Range = 1, foe can counterattack regardless of unit's range, or foe's Range is the same as the distance between unit and foe.
After-combat movement effects do not occur.
Skill effect's Range is treated as 1.
This Style can be used only once per turn.
――――――――――――――――――――――――――
【Arcane Style】
Change Style using the Style button at the bottom of the screen.
A unit's Style is only active when that unit is taking an action. If unit is deployed using Pair Up or is equipped with skills (excluding status effects) that can trigger other Styles, this arcane weapon's Style does not take effect (the Styles of the other skills can still be triggered).

special.d: Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Def.
Boosts damage by 80% of unit's Def.

Boosts damage by 80% of the greater of unit's Spd or Def when Special triggers.
Inflicts penalty on foe’s Atk/Def = highest penalty on each stat between target and foes within 2 spaces of target (calculates each stat penalty independently) and reduces damage from foe's first attack by 40% during combat ("first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes).

a.d: If unit initiates combat or is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Spd+2 to unit, unit deals +X damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's first attack by X during combat (X = number of allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit; max 2; "first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes).

If unit initiates combat or is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Spd+4 to unit, unit deals +X damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's first attack by X during combat (X = number of allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit × 2; max 4; "first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes).

If unit initiates combat or is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Spd+6 to unit, unit deals +X damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's first attack by X during combat (X = number of allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit × 2; max 6; "first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes).

Enables【Canto (Dist. +1; Max ４)】.
If unit initiates combat or if there is an ally within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit, grants Atk/Def+10 to unit, unit deals +X × 4 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's first attack by X × 3 during combat ("first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes; X = number of allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit; max 3).
【Canto (Dist. +1; Max ４)】
After an attack, Assist skill, or structure destruction, unit can move spaces = number of spaces from start position to end position of unit before the above, +1. (Max ４.)
(Unit moves according to movement type. Once per turn. Cannot attack or assist. Only highest value applied. Does not stack. After moving, if a skill that grants another action would be triggered (like with Galeforce), Canto will trigger after the granted action. Unit's base movement has no effect on movement granted. Cannot warp (using skills like Wings of Mercy) a distance greater than unit would be able to move with normal Canto movement.)

b.d:
At start of turn and after unit acts (if Canto triggers, after Canto), inflicts Atk/Spd/Def-7, 【Frozen】, and【Sabotage】on closest foes and foes within 2 spaces of those foes through their next actions.
Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def-5 on foe, unit deals damage = 20% of the greater of unit's Spd or Def (excluding area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's attacks by 20% of the greater of unit's Spd or Def (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and grants Special cooldown count-X to unit before unit's first attack and before unit's first follow-up attack during combat (X = number of spaces from start position to end position of whoever initiated combat; max 2), and also, if unit's Spd > foe's Spd or unit's Def > foe's Def, unit attacks twice during combat.
If unit initiates combat and foe's attack can trigger foe's Special, foe cannot trigger Specials during combat.
【Frozen】
Increases Spd difference necessary for unit to make a follow-up attack by X and decreases Spd difference necessary for foe to make a follow-up attack by X during combat (if foe's Def > unit's Def, X = 10 + difference between Def stats × 2; otherwise, X = 10).
【Sabotage】
Inflicts penalty on unit's Atk/Spd/Def/Res during combat = highest penalty on each stat between unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit. Calculates each stat penalty independently.

c.d: At start of turn, grants Atk/Def+1 to ally with the highest Atk+Def total for 1 turn. (Excludes unit.)
At start of turn, grants Atk/Def+3 to ally with the highest Atk+Def total for 1 turn. (Excludes unit.)
At start of turn, grants Atk/Def+5 to ally with the highest Atk+Def total for 1 turn. (Excludes unit.)

At start of player phase or enemy phase, grants【Atk Liberate】and【Def Liberate】to unit and allies closest to foes (excluding unit) for 1 turn.
Grants Atk/Def+4 to unit during combat.
For unit and allies on the map with the 【Atk Liberate】or【Def Liberate】effects active, deals damage during combat = number of【Bonus】effects active on unit or ally + 5, excluding stat bonuses (max 10; excluding area-of-effect Specials).
【Atk Liberate】
Grants bonus to Atk during combat = number of【Bonus】effects active on unit, excluding stat bonuses, + 4 (max 8).
【Def Liberate】
Grants bonus to Def during combat = number of【Bonus】effects active on unit, excluding stat bonuses, + 4 (max 8).
【Bonus】
All effects that last "for 1 turn" or "that turn only." Includes bonuses granted by a skill like Rally or Hone and positive status effects (extra movement or effects like Dominance).
